skill.name: backlog-manager
skill.description: Manage a living product backlog by collecting ideas, asking follow-up questions, merging duplicates, and updating docs/需求池.md after user confirmation.
skill.summary: Turns scattered product ideas into a confirmed, organized backlog file.
skill.author: yunshu0909

security_audit.summary: Static command-execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code and fenced template syntax. The high-entropy heuristic is also a false positive because SKILL.md is readable backlog-management guidance with no obfuscated payload or prompt injection evidence.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (7.03 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 19 contains a Markdown inline path for docs/需求池.md, not Ruby or shell execution. No command is executed or constructed there.
Line 25 opens a Markdown code fence for a backlog file template. The fenced content is documentation text and contains no executable command invocation.
Line 77 closes the Markdown code fence that began on line 25. This is a formatting marker, not shell backtick execution.
SKILL.md is readable Markdown with Chinese product workflow text and a file template. I found no binary payload, encrypted content, or concealed instructions.

content.value_statement: Product ideas often arrive as scattered notes without clear ownership or status. This skill turns them into a confirmed backlog file.
actual_capabilities: Creates or updates docs/需求池.md using a defined Markdown structure.
Asks about pain point, frequency, and current workaround before adding ideas.
Suggests merges with existing backlog items and waits for user confirmation.
Classifies items as ready, needs thought, parked, or completed.
Reviews backlog items and proposes cleanup, promotion, or follow-up questions.
Compares ready items by frequency, workaround cost, and ROI when planning a version.
limitations: It does not replace product strategy, PRD writing, design, or development workflows.
It needs user confirmation before changing categories, merging items, or selecting work.
It manages one documented backlog file and does not sync with external issue trackers.
It depends on the user to provide real pain points and decisions.

use_cases.title: Capture Feature Ideas
use_cases.description: Turn a quick user complaint or feature thought into a confirmed backlog entry.

use_cases.title: Clean Up Product Requests
use_cases.description: Review old backlog items, remove stale ideas, and promote clearer requests after approval.

use_cases.title: Choose Next Version Scope
use_cases.description: Compare ready backlog items by frequency, workaround cost, and expected return.

prompt_templates.title: Add a New Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: I want to add a backlog idea: users cannot quickly find old invoices. Ask what you need, then prepare an entry.

prompt_templates.title: Merge Similar Requests
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the backlog and check whether this new request overlaps with existing items: export customer notes to CSV.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Backlog
prompt_templates.prompt: Review docs/需求池.md and suggest which items are stale, clearer, or still vague. Wait for my approval before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Select Version Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose candidates for the next version from items marked ready. Compare them by frequency, workaround cost, and ROI.

output_examples.input: Users keep asking for saved filters, but I am not sure if it is worth building.
output_examples.output: The skill asks about the pain point, usage frequency, and current workaround. It then drafts a backlog entry and waits for confirmation.

output_examples.input: Please organize the backlog before we plan the next release.
output: Lists stale items with reasons for removal.
Identifies vague items that need one or two questions.
Suggests ready items for comparison without making the final decision.

output_examples.input: Mark the invoice search item as completed in version 0.12.
output_examples.output: The skill moves the item to completed, records the version and date, and updates the overview status.

best_practices: Give real user pain points instead of broad feature names.
Confirm merges and category changes before asking the skill to edit the backlog.
Review the backlog regularly so outdated items do not hide important work.
anti_patterns: Do not use the backlog as a full project plan or sprint board.
Do not ask the skill to invent requirements without user evidence.
Do not skip confirmation before merging or moving backlog items.

faq.question: What file does this skill maintain?
faq.answer: It maintains docs/需求池.md, creating it from the included Markdown template when needed.

faq.question: Can it choose the next feature for me?
faq.answer: It compares candidate items, but the user makes the final product decision.

faq.question: Does it write PRDs or designs?
faq.answer: No. It stops when an item is clear enough to enter a separate design or PRD workflow.

faq.question: How does it prevent duplicate backlog items?
faq.answer: It reads existing entries, suggests possible merges, and waits for user confirmation.

faq.question: Can it handle vague ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks focused questions, then files unclear ideas as items that need more thought.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
